name: Click Hitbox Trail
description: Shows a colour-coded player hitbox trail after death.

stored-positions.name: Stored Positions
stored-positions.description: Number of recent hitbox positions to retain (maximum 1024).

reset-on-death.name: Reset Positions on Death
reset-on-death.description: Clear the previous trail when an attempt ends.

darken-by-age.name: Darken by Age
darken-by-age.description: Darken older positions in the trail.

colour-clicks.name: Colour Clicks
colour-clicks.description: Use separate colours for clicks and releases.

normal-thickness.name: Normal Trail Thickness
normal-thickness.description: Outline thickness while the player is normal size.

mini-thickness.name: Mini Trail Thickness
mini-thickness.description: Outline thickness while the player is mini size.

blue-hitbox-thickness.name: Blue Hitbox Thickness
blue-hitbox-thickness.description: Outline thickness of the small blue collision hitbox.

mini-blue-hitbox-thickness.name: Mini Blue Hitbox Thickness
mini-blue-hitbox-thickness.description: Outline thickness of the small blue collision hitbox while mini.
